V-M-TUI-RECORDS.Scenario: Open help from each panel and return with any key without triggering that key's records action; preserve selection, page, scroll position, and existing errors across resizing.
Help actions and mouse events do not mutate records or access persistence; dialog insert mode retains ? and q as text.
Compact and wide snapshots preserve terminal modes and dialog cursors while showing help/load/save/quit hints in the inactive-color footer.
On either active panel, gg selects the first row and G selects the last row; ge and gs continue to change panel focus.
Questionnaire transitions retain alternate-screen mode and records selections, pagination, scroll position, and errors; cancelling or completing skipped setup does not trigger records actions.
s/l start asynchronous save/load only from records. Transfers prevent overlap and unsafe edits; successful restore refreshes units/data while retaining selected IDs and terminal dimensions.
V-M-TUI-RECORDS.TraceAssertion: TestRecordsSaveLoadShortcuts and TestRecordsTransferFailuresAndInputOwnership verify temporary-database restore, progress, resize, selected-set retention, missing preference absence, failure preservation, input isolation, and stale-message rejection.
TestRecordsHelpStatePreservation compares rendered records and browsing state across help transitions and resizing.
TestRecordsHelpInputIsolation observes zero transaction calls and unchanged records after help input; TestRecordsHelpQuitAndDialogInput checks quit and text-entry routing.
TestRecordsVimRowJumpShortcuts verifies active-panel first and last row jumps and preserves Home, End, ge, and gs behavior.
TestQuestionnaireStatePreservation verifies r entry, escape/skip return, terminal mode continuity, retained state, and consistent pagination after resizing from either active panel.

V-M-TUI-HELP.Scenario: Render titled, tab-aligned groups without a separate page title using one-row vertical and two-column horizontal padding; use active-panel color for keys and inactive-border color for borderless records hints.
Place groups side by side when space allows, stack on compact widths, and reach all content by scrolling.
Render home/gg, end/G, r reset setup, l load, and s save in help; l is absent from next-page bindings and separate Preferences/Sync destinations remain removed.
V-M-TUI-HELP.TraceAssertion: TestHelpRendering checks content, display bounds, and hints; TestHelpScrollingAndResize checks content accessibility and scroll behavior.
TestHelpRendering checks that home/gg, end/G, reset setup, and save/load are documented and obsolete screen/pagination bindings are absent.

V-M-TUI-STARTER.Scenario: Ctrl+C and Ctrl+Z emit quit in records and dialogs; every key delegates from help and returns to records.
Exercise records, help, open-dialog, and questionnaire states with the actual model and a temporary SQLite database; q remains text in dialogs and setup.
V-M-TUI-STARTER.TraceAssertion: TestGlobalQuitShortcuts asserts tea.QuitMsg and zero child calls for control shortcuts; TestApplicationQuitContexts checks all shortcuts across real application states.

V-M-TUI-QUESTIONNAIRE.Scenario: A missing preferences row opens unit setup, then provider setup; skipped answers and cancelled setup leave application tables untouched. An explicitly saved preference suppresses later automatic setup.

r reopens setup while retaining records selection, pages, offsets, errors, and existing settings. Dialog and help input retain ownership; p no longer opens a screen and s remains a records-only save action.
Unit/provider/code steps fill the usable terminal with main-view spacing and a complete border; compact/tiny/zero layouts remain bounded. Native input cursor stays in bounds and code input is masked.

Async authorization and saves support invalid input, failure retry, cancellation, and stale-message rejection; successful completion updates visible weights. ctrl+r retries with a fresh session; ctrl+o exposes the complete scrollable URL at compact sizes.
V-M-TUI-QUESTIONNAIRE.TraceAssertion: TestQuestionnaireFirstStart and TestQuestionnaireResetAndSelectivePersistence use temporary SQLite databases to assert presence-based startup and selective/no-write completion.

TestQuestionnaireDropboxLinkingAndSkippedPreferences verifies optional preferences and verified-account persistence; TestQuestionnaireInvalidInputAndAuthorizationFailure checks invalid answers and failed exchange.

TestQuestionnaireFullScreenLayout verifies exact dimensions, frame/padding, modes, cursor alignment, long Unicode content, and resizing. TestQuestionnaireStatePreservation and TestQuestionnaireShortcutIsolation verify records and input ownership.
TestQuestionnaireAuthorizationRetryAndURL verifies cancellation of old authorization ownership, fresh retries, full-screen compact URL scrolling, and skipped retry completion.
TestQuestionnaireSaveFailureCanRetry and TestQuestionnaireStaleMessagesAreIgnored verify retry behavior and cancellation ownership.

V-M-APP-QUESTIONNAIRE.Scenario: An empty completion does not start a transaction. Explicit answers validate through constructors and save together; credential failure rolls back preferences and identity.
V-M-APP-QUESTIONNAIRE.TraceAssertion: TestCompleteQuestionnaireSkippedHasNoTransaction and TestCompleteQuestionnaireAtomicRollback verify zero-write skipping and atomic rollback. Startup integration tests verify successful selective persistence.

V-M-INFRA-DROPBOX-AUTH.Scenario: Injected browser and HTTP adapters verify authorization-code PKCE parameters, offline/file scopes and explicit reapproval, code/verifier exchange, verified account ID, encrypted credentials, and private key creation without live sign-in.

Invalid/rejected token responses, missing configuration, cancellation, and browser fallback stay usable and expose no token plaintext; authenticated encryption rejects tampering and wrong account/role bindings.
V-M-INFRA-DROPBOX-AUTH.TraceAssertion: TestDropboxPKCEAndEncryptedCredentials checks challenge correspondence and encrypted round trips. TestDropboxSignInFailuresAndBrowserFallback checks sanitized failures and no premature key writes. TestBrowserOverrideUsesLiteralArguments checks platform launch arguments and literal browser overrides; credential tests check random nonces, authenticated binding, and file permissions.

V-M-DOMAIN-IDENTITY.Scenario: Dropbox identities and opaque encrypted credentials round trip; unsupported providers and missing identity references fail.
V-M-DOMAIN-IDENTITY.TraceAssertion: TestIdentityRepository exercises identity and credentials persistence and provider/reference validation. TestDropboxStateStoreRoundTripAndRefresh also exercises latest linked-account selection.

V-M-DOMAIN-USER-PREFERENCES.Scenario: Absent preferences return a validated kg default without creating a row. Explicit unit completion persists kg/lb and updates visible sets; skipping on reset retains existing preferences.
V-M-DOMAIN-USER-PREFERENCES.TraceAssertion: TestPreferencesReadDoesNotCreateRow verifies repeated write-free reads and explicit-save presence. TestQuestionnaireResetAndSelectivePersistence verifies startup/reset persistence; TestQuestionnaireSaveFailureCanRetry verifies visible conversion only after a successful save.

V-M-APP-REMOTE-STATE.Scenario: Versioned snapshots contain exercises, sets, and optional preferences, excluding local account credentials. Constructors and cross-record validation reject malformed restore data before writes.
V-M-APP-REMOTE-STATE.TraceAssertion: TestRemoteSnapshotRejectsInvalidBackups rejects unknown versions, duplicate IDs/names, missing exercise references, zero timestamps, invalid units, NaN, and storage overflow. TestRemoteStateHandlerValidatesBeforeRestore ensures failed/invalid downloads cannot call local replace.

V-M-INFRA-DROPBOX-STATE.Scenario: Injected HTTP transports exercise the actual Dropbox refresh/upload/download endpoints, fixed backup path, overwrite semantics, encrypted token persistence, and absence of credential fields in uploaded data. A local HTTP server enforces upload Content-Type and download's absent Content-Type and empty body on serialized requests.
Missing accounts/backups, denied scopes, malformed snapshots, provider errors, oversized data, cancellation, and invalid refresh responses fail without plaintext leakage or unsafe transfer.
V-M-INFRA-DROPBOX-STATE.TraceAssertion: TestDropboxStateStoreRoundTripAndRefresh verifies latest-account selection, public-client refresh parameters, encrypted updated credentials, content request headers, and snapshot round trip. TestDropboxContentWireContract reproduces rejection of the old download header and verifies corrected upload/download HTTP contracts. TestDropboxBadRequestDiagnostics checks plain-text and JSON scope failures, safe request IDs, and response-body secrecy. TestDropboxScopeErrorVariants covers app-ID wording, legacy endpoint denials, JSON tag-only errors, required permission guidance, unrelated bad requests, and response-body secrecy. TestDropboxStateFailuresAndExpiredRetry checks sanitized errors and a single expired-token retry. TestDropboxTransferLimitsAndRefreshFailures verifies 16 MiB bounds, in-flight cancellation, and unchanged credentials after invalid refresh.

V-M-INFRA-PERSISTENCE-SQLITE.TraceAssertion: TestRemoteStateAtomicRestore injects a set-insert failure after deletes to prove rollback; successful restore replaces workout data and preserves local identities/credentials. TestRemoteStateBootstrapWithoutLinkedAccount verifies real handler wiring without network or default preference writes.
V-M-INFRA-PERSISTENCE-SQLITE.Scenario: SQLite migration creates identity tables and cascade relationship; repository tests verify encrypted credential round trips and write-free preference defaults. Questionnaire integration verifies transaction-context persistence and atomic rollback. Backup export preserves preference absence and atomic restore retains local identities.

V-M-DOMAIN-EXERCISE.Scenario: Exercise construction rejects empty IDs and names and out-of-range body-weight shares.

V-M-DOMAIN-SET.Scenario: Set construction rejects empty set and exercise IDs and validates weight and rest values.

V-M-DOMAIN-SHARED-WEIGHT.Scenario: Weight and weight-unit constructors reject unsupported or empty unit values.
